replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: Good context to add - Lucy (Australopithecus afarensis) was found in Ethiopia, while Kenya has its own major hominid finds too, like the Turkana Boy and Homo habilis remains. Both countries share real claim to the "cradle of humanity" title.

comments.text: KNM WT 15.000     Could have been a fugitive,   or  a lost/expulsed  member of an expedition/migration  to those   territories made  much later by  much modern humans.

replies.author: @WhereonEarth4K
replies.text: Interesting alternate theory, though the scientific consensus places KNM-WT 15000 (Turkana Boy) as Homo erectus from roughly 1.5 million years ago, well before modern humans existed to be "left behind" by an expedition.
